A1_S4_D3: ^Narrator: As the day wanes, you regroup with Chione, who gives you instructions for when to grab dinner and where to turn in for the night.
^Chione: Elder Silas is pretty busy today, but he’s allowed you to stay here for the night in one of our guesthouses.
^Chione: I’m sure today must’ve been nothing short of exhausting, but you can rest easy with our hunters around!
^Noelle: Hunters? You mean the Forest Watchers?
^Chione: Yes! While they don’t ‘hunt’ anything in particular, they are highly trained to respond to all sorts of situations.
^Narrator: You imagine having Amaya as one of the guards in your home island. Like Chione says — she does give off the impression of someone formidable, despite your short introduction.
^Noelle: Thank you, Chione. Is there enough room for both me and Amelia?
^Chione: Yep! You’ll find two mattresses rolled up and ready to use. Amelia, I wasn’t sure if you were going to return to your pack or not, so…
^Narrator: Amelia turns her face away with a huff.
^Amelia: No, I’m staying here. I kind of promised Noelle I’d accompany her, so…
^Chione: Good thing I’ve prepared two beds just in case!
^Chione: I’ll see you tomorrow. For now, just focus on getting some rest.
